about.p1: I'm a passionate Full Stack Developer with over a decade of experience building web applications that solve real-world problems. My journey started in 2014 with PHP and Python, and since then I've evolved through every wave of web technology, from jQuery to modern frameworks like React and Vue.js.
about.p2_prefix: Currently, I work as a Senior Full Stack Python Developer at
about.p2_suffix: , a remote-first software consultancy where I build high-impact products for clients.
about.p3: I'm deeply invested in the AI revolution, I've built production AI agents using LangGraph and LangSmith, and I leverage tools like Claude Code daily to amplify my development workflow. I believe the best developers combine deep technical expertise with the ability to harness AI as a force multiplier.
